name: DiscountFlow Studio for WooCommerce
author: prokashsarker2026

sections.description:
DiscountFlow Studio for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin that adds advanced discount capabilities to your WooCommerce store. Create flexible discount rules to boost sales and increase customer engagement.

Key Features:

  • Global Discounts – Apply discounts to all products at once with percentage or fixed amount options
  • Product-Specific Discounts – Set custom discounts for individual products
  • Quantity-Based Discounts – Offer tiered discounts based on cart quantity (e.g., 10% off 2-3 items, 15% off 4+ items)
  • Promotional Banners – Display attractive promo banners on product pages with discount information
  • Coupon Code Integration – Auto-generate WooCommerce coupons and display promo codes to customers
  • Discount Badges – Show discount badges on product listings
  • Cart & Checkout Display – Display discount information in cart and checkout pages
  • HPOS Compatible – Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage

A brief Markdown

DiscountFlow Studio for WooCommerce is designed to help store owners create flexible discount strategies to increase sales and customer satisfaction.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/discountflow-studio-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Discount Settings to configure your discount rules
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, DiscountFlow Studio for WooCommerce requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Can I use multiple discount types together?

Yes, you can combine global discounts, product-specific discounts, and quantity-based discounts. The plugin will apply the highest applicable discount to each product.

Are the discounts applied before or after taxes?

Discounts are applied to the product price before taxes are calculated, following standard WooCommerce behavior.

Can I customize the promotional banner design?

Yes, you can customize the CSS by editing the frontend.css file in the plugin’s css directory.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin works with both simple and variable products.
